"""Verification oracle for per-phase evidence building and gate transitions (task p11-build-evidence-oracle-perphase)."""
import json
import pytest
from ngv2.conductor_seams import build_default_seams
from ngv2.transition_planner import PHASE_ORDER
_REAL_POC_SOURCE = "import target_pkg\ndef go():\n    return target_pkg.exploit('payload')\n"
_TARGET_NAMES = ['target_pkg']
_TARGET_SOURCE = "def handler(req):\n    os.system(req.params['cmd'])\n    return 200\n"
_PRESENT_SIGNATURE = "os.system(req.params['cmd'])"
_REACHABLE_CALL_SITES = ['os.system(user_input)']
_SINK_NAME = 'os.system'

def test_oracle_imports_and_seam_shape():
    """Verify that build_default_seams can be imported and returns the correct seam shape including build_evidence and run_gates."""
    from ngv2.gate_executor import run_gates

    class FakeDB:

        def get_session(self, sid):
            return None

        def save_session(self, sid, state):
            pass
    seams = build_default_seams('s1', FakeDB(), None, {'session_id': 's1'})
    assert isinstance(seams, dict)
    assert 'build_evidence' in seams
    assert 'run_gates' in seams
    assert callable(seams['build_evidence'])
    assert callable(seams['run_gates'])
    assert seams['run_gates'] is run_gates

def test_oracle_phase_order_consecutive_count():
    """Verify the length, uniqueness, and consecutive transitions count of PHASE_ORDER."""
    assert isinstance(PHASE_ORDER, tuple)
    assert len(PHASE_ORDER) == 11
    assert len(set(PHASE_ORDER)) == 11
    transitions = [(PHASE_ORDER[i], PHASE_ORDER[i + 1]) for i in range(len(PHASE_ORDER) - 1)]
    assert len(transitions) == 10

def test_oracle_build_evidence_emits_eight_keys(tmp_path):
    """Verify that build_evidence outputs exactly 8 keys under full state inputs when state['evidence'] is empty."""
    dummy_file = tmp_path / 'app.py'
    dummy_file.write_text('def run():\n    pass\n')
    state = {'repo': str(tmp_path), 'target': 'app', 'prior_findings': [{'id': 'F1', 'title': 'SQLi', 'file': 'app.py', 'sink_name': _SINK_NAME, 'call_sites': _REACHABLE_CALL_SITES, 'expected_signature': _PRESENT_SIGNATURE}], 'parked_package': {'poc': _REAL_POC_SOURCE}, 'evidence': {'detonation_report_raw': {'detonated': True, 'reproduced': True, 'verdict': 'confirmed'}}}
    seams = build_default_seams('s1', None, None, {'session_id': 's1'})
    ev = seams['build_evidence'](state)
    expected_keys = {'poc_source', 'target_import_names', 'target_source', 'expected_signature', 'sink_name', 'call_sites', 'detonation_report', 'source_ready'}
    assert set(ev.keys()) == expected_keys

def test_oracle_source_ready_is_from_repo_not_findings():
    """Verify that source_ready derives from repo presence/validity and not findings."""
    seams = build_default_seams('s1', None, None, {'session_id': 's1'})
    state_with_repo = {'repo': '/some/valid/path', 'prior_findings': [], 'evidence': {}}
    ev1 = seams['build_evidence'](state_with_repo)
    assert ev1.get('source_ready') is True
    state_no_repo = {'repo': None, 'prior_findings': [{'id': 'F1'}], 'evidence': {}}
    ev2 = seams['build_evidence'](state_no_repo)
    assert ev2.get('source_ready') is not True

def test_oracle_full_state_advances_all_transitions(tmp_path):
    """Verify that a fully populated state with positive evidence advances all transitions."""
    dummy_file = tmp_path / 'app.py'
    dummy_file.write_text('def run():\n    pass\n')
    state = {'repo': str(tmp_path), 'target': 'app', 'prior_findings': [{'id': 'F1', 'title': 'SQLi', 'file': 'app.py', 'sink_name': _SINK_NAME, 'call_sites': _REACHABLE_CALL_SITES, 'expected_signature': _PRESENT_SIGNATURE}], 'parked_package': {'poc': _REAL_POC_SOURCE}, 'evidence': {'findings': [{'id': 1}], 'triage_result': True, 'verify_result': True, 'novelty_result': True, 'report_artifact': True, 'approval': True, 'submission_result': True, 'detonation_report_raw': {'detonated': True, 'reproduced': True, 'verdict': 'confirmed'}}}
    seams = build_default_seams('s1', None, None, {'session_id': 's1'})
    ev = seams['build_evidence'](state)
    transitions = [(PHASE_ORDER[i], PHASE_ORDER[i + 1]) for i in range(len(PHASE_ORDER) - 1)]
    for from_phase, to_phase in transitions:
        res = seams['run_gates'](from_phase, to_phase, ev)
        assert res['advance'] is True, f'Failed to advance from {from_phase} to {to_phase} with full evidence: {res}'
        assert res['blocked_by'] == []

def test_oracle_empty_state_fails_closed_all_transitions():
    """Verify that an empty state processed through build_evidence fails closed on all transitions."""
    seams = build_default_seams('s1', None, None, {'session_id': 's1'})
    empty_state = {'evidence': {}}
    ev = seams['build_evidence'](empty_state)
    transitions = [(PHASE_ORDER[i], PHASE_ORDER[i + 1]) for i in range(len(PHASE_ORDER) - 1)]
    for from_phase, to_phase in transitions:
        res = seams['run_gates'](from_phase, to_phase, ev)
        assert res['advance'] is False, f'Unexpected advance from {from_phase} to {to_phase} with empty evidence'
        assert len(res['blocked_by']) > 0

def test_oracle_build_evidence_determinism(tmp_path):
    """Verify that build_evidence is deterministic and produces identical results across calls."""
    dummy_file = tmp_path / 'app.py'
    dummy_file.write_text('def run():\n    pass\n')
    state = {'repo': str(tmp_path), 'target': 'app', 'prior_findings': [{'id': 'F1', 'title': 'SQLi', 'file': 'app.py', 'sink_name': _SINK_NAME, 'call_sites': _REACHABLE_CALL_SITES, 'expected_signature': _PRESENT_SIGNATURE}], 'parked_package': {'poc': _REAL_POC_SOURCE}, 'evidence': {'detonation_report_raw': {'detonated': True, 'reproduced': True, 'verdict': 'confirmed'}}}
    seams = build_default_seams('s1', None, None, {'session_id': 's1'})
    res1 = seams['build_evidence'](state)
    json1 = json.dumps(res1, sort_keys=True)
    for _ in range(10):
        res2 = seams['build_evidence'](state)
        assert res2 == res1
        assert json.dumps(res2, sort_keys=True) == json1
